Lookup of 55 native single-byte converter descriptors, generated from the authenticated LibreOffice descriptor capture already used by SAL converter tests.

The duplicate 47-entry handwritten single-byte switch is replaced by the existing pinned 55-descriptor capture, making all represented reverse data reachable through the shared factory. JIS X0201 records its actual null text-to-Unicode callback separately from absent encoding data. Native unsigned16 lookup binding is preserved. Other native registry encoding families and native function-pointer ABI remain unported.

Original XMLFile2UTFConverter/Text2UnicodeConverter/Unicode2TextConverter stream, OString, Sequence, RTL descriptor/context, default flags, accumulation, encoding scan/removal, grow/retry and reverse member ownership are represented without TextDecoder or alternate UNO/encoding providers. Actual logical cells lower native pointer views at the RTL boundary. Original comphelper variadic concatSequences uses actual compiled Sequence T/sizeof and existing CPPU initialized C assignment owners; actual scalar/OUString references are exercised. Missing original Shift-JIS descriptor is wired with full256 lead and256 reverse entries using unchanged original payload pointers and actual shared MS932 EUDC object. Both tables match numeric fields/symbolic pointers in exact source order. Existing compiled original DBCS witness now includes encoding64; all11 previous digests/source hashes remain unchanged, new full-BMP reverse digest and151032-case defined round-trip profile come from compiled original source. Initial tests incorrectly assumed canonical wave/surrogate behavior; expectations now retain pinned MS-compatible U+FF5E and original no-FLUSH split-surrogate replacement. CALC-363..366 / WRITER238..241 preserve EOF prefix loss, quote ordering, split replacement and compatibility mapping. Whole4-owner coverage100 still fails; source/counters/exclusions/thresholds are unchanged. Actual SAX InputSource/parser byte admission, package/model/controller/factory/filter/workbook/DOCX/XLSX/worker/UI paths remain incomplete. Unported RTL descriptors, native ABI/pointer/aggregate copy, allocation/constructor unwind and threads remain unverified. Existing file/autosave/recovery choices are preserved.
